content.rendered:
Mark your calendars for our upcoming Virtual Community Forum! In this live, interactive forum we will be sharing details with you about proposed instructional models for the 2020-21 school year, with a separate presentation for each level — elementary, middle school, and high school — followed by level-specific, facilitated question and answer sessions.

Tuesday, August 11, 2020

Join the forum via Zoom at https://bit.ly/SSDFall2020, or watch the livestream on our YouTube channel at https://bit.ly/SSDyoutube.

Schedule:

  • 5:00-6:00pm – Elementary 
  • 6:15-7:15pm – Middle School
  • 7:30-8:30pm – High School

Can’t watch live? All sessions will be recorded and posted on our YouTube channel to be reviewed at your convenience. 

We hope you can join us for this virtual event!
